description: Angular component for managing data key rows in widget configuration, including form controls, editing, validation, and integration with dialog components.

classes.name: DataKeyRowComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing and managing individual data key entries within widget configuration, supporting form controls, validation, dialog-based editing, and dynamic updates.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls and form group, sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, especially for yAxisIds updates.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form controls with provided DataKey value.

methods.name: editKey
methods.description: Opens dialog for editing DataKey details, updates model upon dialog close.

methods.name: _generateDataKey
methods.description: Generates a DataKey using callback, updates form controls accordingly.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal DataKey model based on form control values and propagates change.
